paragraphs: Students in Ireland can now ask for a place at college. The CAO website opened on Thursday at 12 o'clock.
The CAO is the office for college applications. Students can choose from more than 1,400 courses.
It costs €35 to apply before 20 January. After that day, it costs €50. So it is cheaper to apply early.
Each student gets a CAO number. Students do not need to choose their final courses now. They can change their list until 1 July 2027.
The Leaving Cert is the big exam at the end of school. Students take it in June. Their results help them get a college place.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭的學生現在可以申請大學名額。
CAO網站在週四中午12點開放。
CAO是處理大學申請的機構。
學生可以從1,400多個課程中選擇。
在1月20日前申請要35歐元。
過了那天，就要50歐元。
所以早點申請比較便宜。
每個學生都會得到一個CAO號碼。
學生現在不需要選定最終課程。
他們可以在2027年7月1日前修改志願清單。
Leaving Cert是中學畢業時的大考。
學生在六月參加考試。
他們的成績幫助他們取得大學名額。

paragraphs: Students who want to go to college in Ireland next year can now apply. The Central Applications Office (CAO) opened its online system at midday on Thursday. The CAO handles applications for undergraduate courses at Irish universities and colleges. This year, there are more than 1,400 courses to choose from.
Applying costs €35 if students apply by 20 January. After that date, the fee goes up to €50, so it is cheaper to apply early.

First, students fill in their personal details and get their own CAO number. Students taking the Leaving Cert in 2027 confirm this on the website, while people who have already done the exam give their exam number and year.
Students do not have to make their final course choices yet. They can change them until 5pm on 1 July 2027, after the Leaving Cert exams. A full guide, the CAO Handbook, is on the CAO website.
The Leaving Cert is the final exam in Irish secondary schools, and students' results decide how many CAO points they get. These points are used to give out college places.

CAO處理愛爾蘭各大學和學院大學部課程的申請。

首先，學生要填寫個人資料，並取得自己的CAO號碼。
2027年參加Leaving Cert的學生在網站上確認此號碼，而已經考過的人則提供考試編號和年份。
學生還不必做出最終的課程選擇。
他們可以在Leaving Cert考試之後、2027年7月1日下午5點前修改。

Leaving Cert是愛爾蘭中學的畢業考試，學生的成績決定他們能拿到多少CAO積分。
這些積分被用來分配大學名額。

paragraphs: The Central Applications Office (CAO) portal opened at noon on Thursday, allowing students to apply for undergraduate courses at higher education institutions across Ireland.
Applicants can choose from more than 1,400 courses. The application fee is €35 for those who apply by 20 January, rising to €50 after that deadline.

To register, students enter their personal details and receive a unique CAO number. Those sitting the Leaving Cert in 2027 confirm this on the portal, while applicants who have already taken the exam provide their exam number and year.

Importantly, course choices do not need to be finalised now. Students have until 5pm on 1 July 2027, after the Leaving Cert, to settle on their preferences. The full CAO Handbook is available on the CAO website.
The Leaving Cert is the State exam taken at the end of secondary school, and the points students earn in it largely determine which CAO course offers they receive.

paragraphs: The Central Applications Office (CAO) threw open its portal at noon on Thursday, inviting prospective students to seek places on undergraduate programmes at third-level institutions nationwide.
Applicants have an extensive menu of more than 1,400 courses at their disposal. Those who submit an application by 20 January will pay a fee of €35, whereas latecomers will be charged €50.

Registration entails supplying personal details, after which each applicant is issued a unique CAO number. Prospective Leaving Cert candidates for 2027 verify this online, while those who have already sat the exam furnish their exam number and year.

Crucially, nobody is obliged to commit to a final selection at this stage. Applicants may revise their preferences until 5pm on 1 July 2027, once the Leaving Cert is behind them. The comprehensive CAO Handbook can be consulted on the CAO website.
The stakes are high: the points candidates accumulate in the Leaving Cert, the State examination at the end of secondary school, largely dictate which offers they ultimately receive.

paragraphs: The Central Applications Office (CAO) opened its online portal at noon on Thursday, thereby enabling prospective students to apply for undergraduate programmes at higher education institutions throughout Ireland.

Applicants may select from a substantial range of over 1,400 courses. The application fee is €35 for submissions received by 20 January; subsequently, it increases to €50, which provides a clear incentive to apply early.

The registration process requires applicants to provide personal information, upon which they are assigned a unique CAO number. Candidates who will sit the Leaving Certificate in 2027 confirm this number online, whereas those who have previously completed the examination are required to provide their examination number and year.

Significantly, applicants are not obliged to finalise their course preferences at this stage. Their choices may be amended until 5pm on 1 July 2027, by which time candidates will have completed the Leaving Certificate. Comprehensive guidance is available in the CAO Handbook on the official website.
It should be noted that the points obtained in the Leaving Certificate largely determine the course offers that applicants ultimately receive.

To register, students enter their personal details and receive a unique CAO number. Those sitting the Leaving Cert in 2027 confirm this on the portal, while applicants who have already taken the exam provide their exam number and year.

Importantly, course choices do not need to be finalised now. Students have until 5pm on 1 July 2027, after the Leaving Cert, to settle on their preferences. The full CAO Handbook is available on the CAO website.
The Leaving Cert is the State exam taken at the end of secondary school, and the points students earn in it largely determine which CAO course offers they receive.
